title: ⚖️ Multiple Legal Openings in Albemarle County, VA - Up to $200K+ - NewsBreak
text:
1 days ago The legal field in Albemarle County is buzzing this season, with several respected firms and companies hiring experienced attorneys. If you’re ready to grow your career in Charlottesville, these roles offer strong pay, benefits, and professional development.
Corporate Counsel – Anchor Health Properties Employer: Anchor Health Properties
Location: Charlottesville, VA (remote options available)
Salary: $150,000–$200,000+
Type: Full-time
This national healthcare real estate firm seeks a corporate counsel to handle commercial real estate transactions and compliance. Expect generous benefits, including 100% employer-paid health coverage and a 401(k) match .
Transactional Associate Attorney – Lee/Shoemaker PLLC Employer: Lee/Shoemaker PLLC
Location: Charlottesville, VA
Salary: $115,000–$130,000
Type: Full-time, in-person
Join a boutique construction law firm advising clients on contracts, mergers, and risk management. Ideal for attorneys with 2–5 years of experience and a Virginia bar license.
Litigation Associate – Mayo Law Group Employer: Mayo Law Group
Location: Charlottesville, VA (hybrid remote)
Salary: From $100,000+
Type: Full-time
Work on high-stakes defamation and business litigation cases with a small, experienced team. Offers flexible scheduling , bonuses , and a chance to sharpen your trial skills.
